Results.ReviewText:
I like my grills hot, the hotter the grill the faster my food cooks. For fragile foods that need lower temperature I still want an ultra hot sear temperature so I can get that grill char on the surface. You ignite this thing and leave it for five minutes on full blast and when you open it up you wonder if you’re looking inside of a grill or a blast furnace. 

I’ve been grilling since I was 7 years old. Started on an old Weber coal dome then went to a small propane grill from a knock off brand to a massive grill. Then I moved out of my parents house and needed a grill at my own place, not too small not too big. This grill is just right.

Where it really excels is in searing and high temperature cooking. I got this grill about a month ago and about a month ago is the first time I myself have been able to get reliable grill sear marks day in and day out. 

The build quality is what you expect from Weber, built like a tank and made to last. 

I use a grill cover on mine and recommend anyone buying one get a grill cover right off the bat, there’s a lot of electronics in these grills these days and no matter how many times the manual says “Electronics are sealed against water ingress” you will get problems eventually! 

It has a 10 year warranty so I know I made a good investment and also know because I bought from a company that produces their product domestically.

Photos.Caption: nice igniter, but concerned the rubber will not hold up over time
Cap of wheel fell off this morning, again
Table flexes a bit as I use it to pick up this end (recommended method by Weber) to wheel it back into garage.
Occasionally table slips off these bolts as I'm moving the Weber.  Not happy with this design.

Results.ReviewText:
Purchased this around July 4th, 2019.  It's currently mid August.  The grill's dials and igniter work well (although I can foresee the rubber around the igniter disintegrating over time).  The grill's wheels are attached with pins and plastic covers (one of which continuously falls off on the back wheel).  The grilling grate seems sturdy but that is the only part of the grill that feels that way.  The is no good way to move the grill despite the wheels and a previous responded recommendation by Weber to "recommend standing on the left side of the grill with the table in the up position and fully engaged. Then, lift the table straight up with both hands and you can move the grill like a wheelbarrow."  The table is quite flimsy and flexes when I do this (quite alarming) and doesn't always catch well in the "fully engaged position"- the result is the table disengages and the grill falls back to the ground.  To much of this over time will make the table unusable/unreliable.

I checked out the larger, more expensive Weber's at the store this week.  While some of them appear a little sturdier, they are not durable/solid like our older Weber grills.
We have had many Weber grills in our 50 some years; 2 sizes of charcoal kettle (have never needed replacing - we take very good care of our stuff), a pellet smoker, and gas grills (we grill several time weekly throughout the year, this is our 3rd Weber gas grill). With the kids grown we chose a smaller gas grill as we never use the gas grill for entertaining, just for ourselves - meat and lots of vegetables.  I am very disappointed, will look closer at our future purchases, investigating other brands

Great tasting food, even heating....the BEST customer service to register for warranty, etc. have owned grill in the past...will never own anything but Weber, but with that said, I’m pretty sure this will be the last grill I ever own do to it’s quality.
Results.Title: Great grill, great quality

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the second Weber grill I've had over the past 15 years...........and my first one is still working.  The quality, workmanship, and the way it cooks evenly is great.  I would never buy any other grill.
Results.Title: Love my Weber

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: E-310 was purchased around one month ago, I've grilled maybe 6 or 7 times and it does what it's supposed to do. There are a lot of other gill companies out there but theres just something about a Weber Grill thats special. The special discounted price of $450.00 w/ free assembly and delivery (and removal of old grill) from the retail store where I bought it made the purchase a no brainier.
Results.Title: really nice compact Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have been using this grill for a month and I love it! Easy to start nice features and if you follow the cooking times in the guide your burgers,  steak etc will come out just the way you want...delicious!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Bought my grill and happy with it . The only thing is I wish they put 4 wheels instead the 2 flat legs . It makes it hard to move . Every time we move it to grill it takes 2 people.
Results.Title: Dependable products for years to come.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill a month ago to replace an ancient Weber gas grill which finally died. We are pleased with its performance.  A pleasure to use. My only negative is the old grill had a hole to use to light the grill if the push button didn’t work. This one has an awkward clip on a chain in which to insert a small lit match. Hope the push button lasts forever. Otherwise, great product.
Results.Title: Reliable Workhorse

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love the ease of operation, gets hot quick, easy to clear.
Results.Title: Great value

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This grill can hold a lot of food!  Finding out that no flair ups is a true statement.  The design is functional and appealing
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill for my son as a birthday present couple years ago.  When he moved out recently and took his grill, I got the exact same one to replace it.  LOVE this grill.  I am very much an amateur with grilling and it's super easy to use and the food is always GREAT!!
Results.Title: Excellent small grill!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the first Weber I have purchased. Many people I know have high praise about how well made and performance of the bbq.Time will tell.Looking forward to many years of barbecuing.
Results.Title: Several accessories to purchase

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought our Weber a month ago and have been cookin' up a storm ever since!!
Results.Title: Great Buy!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was thrilled to buy my second Weber grill! It is so easy to use and the food cooked evenly and well.  I was able to fit enough chicken and salmon on at one time to serve eight people. What a great product!
Results.Title: Great power!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill a month ago and love it! Maintains even heat and cleans up like a gem!
Results.Title: Easy clean up!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Even cooking temperature, great quality,well built
Results.Title: Good quality of .materials and construction

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is only my third weber grill as they last for years, I bought it for the open style bottom as the older door type models only held a cleaning brush and were dirt catchers.  I like it so far, the knobs in the front are a better placement as it provides two shelfs rather than the old style which had the knobs on the second shelf.
Results.Title: I have sticked with this brand for years

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Great bbq and get features.  Love how it cooks and it tells you about the propane levels.
Results.Title: Awesome BBQ

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: 1) After a month, I’ve received all the replacement parts and my grill is back in business.  Thank you for 100% replacement for free.  2) This is my 2nd Weber grill.  My first lasted 12 years.  This grill is 15 months old and it has rusted, I’ve replaced several key parts.  What gives?   The cost of a Weber grill is 2-3 times more than most grills.  I am not thrilled with the quality.  3) I would advise anyone having trouble with their grill to call their support team. They are terrific and incredibly helpful.
Results.Title: Three points

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I’m really glad that I purchase this model.Easy to use and gets hot fast.
Results.Title: All around great grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I was blessed to win this BBQ in a golf tournament recently.  It is by far the best barbeque I have ever owned.  It burns clean and hot and does an excellent job of cooking.  Love the propane tank fuel gauge as well.  Just a great barbeque.
Results.Title: Awesome Barbeque!!

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.

45020001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill
45020001.Description: Step up your grilling game with the Spirit II E-310 gas grill. This three burner grill has a spacious grilling area and convenient side tables for placing serving trays, and tool hooks for hanging your tongs and spatula. With the powerful GS4 grilling system and iGrill capability, you're already set up for BBQ success.
